faces.name: Dreamshaper Shaman
faces.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may pay {2}{R} and sacrifice a nonland permanent. If you do, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a nonland permanent card. Put that card onto the battlefield and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

faces.name: Dreams of Laguna
faces.oracleText:
Surveil 1, then draw a card. (To surveil 1, look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.)
Flashback {3}{U} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)

faces.name: Dreams of Steel and Oil
faces.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose an artifact or creature card from it, then choose an artifact or creature card from their graveyard. Exile the chosen cards.

faces.name: Dreams of the Dead
faces.oracleText: {1}{U}: Return target white or black creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. That creature gains "Cumulative upkeep {2}." If the creature would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else. (At the beginning of its controller's upkeep, that player puts an age counter on it, then sacrifices it unless they pay its upkeep cost for each age counter on it.)

faces.name: Dream Spoilers
faces.oracleText:
